title: ‘Merchandise exports grew over 15%’: Piyush Goyal sees strong export growth despite global turmoil
summary: India’s merchandise exports are estimated to have grown by over 15% during April-August this fiscal despite global uncertainties, Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal said. He highlighted the scope to expand goods and services trade with BRICS nations. Official August trade data will be released by the Commerce Ministry on September 15.

title: NSE IPO: Exchange to freeze ISIN from September 11; no offline share transfers allowed until listing
summary: The NSE will freeze its ISIN starting September 11, 2026, ahead of its IPO. Shareholders are advised against pledging shares during the freeze, which prevents transfers without corporate action. Additionally, Indian Bank and others plan to sell stakes as part of the offering process.

title: US stocks calm ahead of midterm polls, but markets may be underpricing the risk
summary: US stocks remain near record highs ahead of the US midterm elections, but unusually low market volatility is raising concerns that investors may be underestimating risks. With the VIX near 15, analysts warn that crowded positioning and limited demand for protection could leave markets vulnerable to a sudden shock.

title: GST growth comparisons can’t be 'apples and oranges' says CBIC; hits back at 'misleading' claims
summary: The CBIC stated that comparing GST revenue figures using different tax bases is misleading.  Growth calculations must be made on a like-for-like basis for meaningful analysis.  The compensation cess was discontinued on most items from September 2025.  Since then, no compensation cess has been collected by the government.  Fair analysis requires comparing comparable datasets for accurate insights.
